title: AUSGETANZT
subtitle: Ein Fall für Zwei
description: At a fundraising party for a refugee centre, lovers SUSAN TRABOLD and ÁLVARO REYES get into an argument. A short time later, the Spanish art professor is found stabbed to death and Susan Trabold is arrested. BENNI HORNBERG is asked by her daughter KIM LORENZ to take over her mother's defence. Was it an act of passion? Did Susan Trabold kill her boyfriend out of jealousy? In their search for exculpatory evidence, Benni and LEO OSWALD discover that the client's daughter was also involved with the victim. However, until recently neither mother nor daughter knew about the love triangle. Another lead leads to an old mate of Leo's - FELIPE MESA. And to TIMO KROLL, a dodgy property shark who is involved in dubious rental speculator deals. While Benni is torn as to whether he can trust his client's statements, MAREN WILLE turns up in Frankfurt - Benni's former fellow student and former great love ...

title: FALSCHES SPIEL
subtitle: EIN FALL FÜR ZWEI
description: Leo is arrested and taken into custody. He is accused of beating the Romanian forced prostitute Melina Dumitru to death. All of Benni's attempts to get his friend out of this awkward situation fail. In the end, it becomes clear that someone is doing everything in their power to put Leo in prison for life with perfectly falsified evidence! He has no other chance: he uses a court hearing to escape. Hunted by the entire Frankfurt police force, Leo and Benni investigate the background to the plot and its masterminds: four years earlier, Leo had played a decisive role in proving the murder of a prostitute to red-light kingpin Hendrik Leibold in an undercover operation with a statement from Melina Dumitru. Although the source of these tips remained a secret, Leibold, now terminally ill, found out who framed him at the time and sought revenge: he had Melina killed and framed Leo for the murder so that he, like Leibold himself, would be imprisoned! But it's only when Leo and Benni find out who else is involved in this plot that they manage to use a trick to prove everything to Leibold and put a stop to it...

title: La sagrada de cuba
subtitle: Trailer
tagline: Screened in numerous Filmfestivals | Exhibited 3 month at the Sprengel Museum Hannover
description: Anyone slaughtering a cow in Cuba can face a prison sentence of up to 30 years. The absurd current situation has its roots in an outdated periodo especial law in the early 1990s. The film tells in small portraits of cow mafias and black market meat, bandits and the shepherds' love for their cows, carnivorous tourists and sleepless shepherds between resignation and hope. With a poetic and ironic look, he offers viewers an insight into a topic that most viewers have been unfamiliar with.

description: In five episodes, the documentary series ‘Neonstaub’ tells a lively chronicle of Hamburg's harbour district St. Pauli and its world-famous amusement mile. title: Wo kein Schatten fällt
subtitle: Trailer
tagline: Premiere International Women's Film Festival LA | Winner of Exground Film Festival
description: After three years in the boarding school, the calm Hanna returns to her home village for the first time. There she is supposed to help out in her father's slaughterhouse over the summer holidays. But Hanna quickly realizes that she is not welcome here. Hanna's mother disappeared into the bog many years ago - and with her three men. The persistent belief among the villagers that Hanna's mother was a witch who lured the men to their deaths still persists. As she becomes more and more like her mother, Hanna also has to live with the suspicions of being obsessed with evil.
